Didn't get these for any aesthetic effect. I sliced my fingernail pretty badly and instead of using bandaids to keep it from splitting more, I bought these and the glue and fake nail seem to be holding my fingernail together pretty well after 3 days.

I wanted to believe all the hype, but alas, this was no good for me. It didn't curl my lashes any better than the drugstore model.

I have very straight and somewhat sparse lashes -- they do take mascara very well though (too faced better than sex is a great buildable mascara, btw)...if only I could get the lashes to curl up they'd be pretty good all things considered. This curler got my hopes up but not the lashes -- in a side by side comparison my old curler (I think it's a Revlon from CVS) did as good if not a little better. Oh well :(

The product is beautiful and realistic but I was a bit upset when I noticed that two pieces had broken off during transit. I would return it for another one but would be afraid I wouldn’t get the replacement back in time for Halloween.
